answer: Before first payout, the holder deposits a hand-drawn karst map with the cave archive, in violet ink, its mouth beneath a walnut tree, and the archive signs an accession slip. Two verifiers match it against the archive's register within a week; a map claimed twice, or no archive, closes both. A deposit costs 2.2 million rupiah, so one holder pays once while a thousand fakes need a thousand and 2.2 billion. The violet map keeps the karst honest.
